senses.definition: (historical) An old Indian unit of weight, equal to 80 tolas, or one fortieth of a maund.
(archaic, now chiefly fantasy) Alternative spelling of sir.
examples: He was knighted and became Ser William.

quotes.text:
"Ser Willem is a good man and true,” said Ser Oswell.
“But not of the Kingsguard,” Ser Gerold pointed out.
